7339.title: Idle plugin-tool response exceeds the fetch body deadline
7339.rootCauseOneLine: The server sends no ongoing body data while a plugin computes, so the daemon's unchanged fetch loses the result to its idle body timeout.
7339.proposedFix: Tested server-only repair: emit JSON whitespace every 30 seconds, disable transformation buffering, and clean up the heartbeat on settlement or cancellation. The unchanged daemon client passes a real-time 310-second call; 44 relevant tests and server typecheck pass. Two files, 142 changed text lines.
7339.caveats: The timeout is reproduced twice in real time. Automatic late detached delivery was not reproduced; the ordinary tool signal is aborted and its registry entry removed. Reproduction source and exact output are inline per reports publication policy.
